entries.name: Form tables, mixed up
entries.summary: Fill in forms from different patterns, not one table at a time
entries.trains: hitting the right form without thinking
entries.doesNotDo: It does not carry into speech on its own. Filling a slot in a table on demand is a long way from producing it mid-sentence.

entries.name: Telling similar sounds apart (minimal pairs)
entries.summary: Two words that differ by one sound — which was it?
entries.doesNotDo: Hearing a difference is not saying it. Training your ear carries over to your mouth only partly, and it trains sounds rather than words.

entries.name: Cloze sentences
entries.summary: One word removed from a sentence; put it back
entries.doesNotDo: The sentence around the gap does much of the work. A cloze you can solve from context alone measures the context, not the form.

entries.name: Rebuilding sentences — tense, negation, person
entries.summary: Take a sentence and change its tense or its person
entries.trains: flexibility with forms you already meet
entries.doesNotDo: It supplies the sentence. You never have to decide what to say, only how to bend it.

entries.name: Working through your own list of mistakes
entries.summary: Work through the mistakes you actually made
entries.trains: your own patterns rather than the average learner's
entries.doesNotDo: It only contains errors you were caught making. Everything you avoid saying never reaches the log.

entries.name: Rule explanation at the point of error
entries.summary: Read why that was wrong, the moment it goes wrong
entries.trains: understanding, exactly when it is wanted
entries.doesNotDo: Understanding a rule is not being able to apply it. It removes confusion; it does not produce automaticity.
